newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL stock market closed for holiday April 18.
newsitem.headline: KL stock market closed for holiday April 18.

text.p: The Malaysian stock market is closed on Friday for the Moslem festival of Eid al-Adha.
On Thursday, Malaysian shares rebounded after a week of sharp falls triggered by the central bank's curbs on property and share financing late last month, analysts and dealers said.
The benchmark Composite Index closed up 16.80 points, or 1.54 percent, at 1,104.58. Market volume stood at 281 million shares valued at 1.64 billion ringgit.
Analysts said investors would remain cautious next week, and would watch movements on Wall Street closely.
